name: @aspen/desktop
description: Electron shell for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Renders the @aspen/app build; contains no UI of its own.

scripts.package: pnpm --filter @aspen/app build:desktop && pnpm build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:dir: pnpm --filter @aspen/app build:desktop && pnpm build:native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
